## Article to drafts

Polls the blog RSS feed. Every NEW article creates one draft request (source type `article`, no web search: 1 AI call). Drafts land in Ciorne; a person approves.

1. Set the **Feed URL** on the RSS node (placeholder: https://example.com/blog/rss.xml).
2. Edit **Config** (site URL, brand, platforms, count).
3. Pick the credential **Agent Social automation** on the HTTP nodes.
4. Activate the workflow.

The event id is `article-<brand>-<hash>`, where the hash is the first 32 characters of the SHA-256 of the item guid (or its link). An article never creates two requests for one brand, and a copy of this workflow for another brand gets its own ids. The first poll after activation only remembers the feed; older articles are not imported.

To run another feed or brand, duplicate the workflow and change the Feed URL, `brand` and `workflowName` in **Config** (a-z, 0-9 and -; it is the name shown on the Automatizari card).
